title: ServiceNow Architect
description:
Exp: 12 years – 17 years


Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Mumbai/Noida/Ahmedabad/Coimbatore/Dehradun


Np: Immediate Joiner


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and customize applications and workflows on the ServiceNow platform (custom apps, or other modules as applicable).
* Build and maintain business rules, client scripts, UI policies, UI actions, ACLs, and workflows/flow designer flows.
* Develop and integrate ServiceNow with third\-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Integration Hub.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and scalable solutions on the platform.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, performance bottlenecks, and defects.
* Collaborate with business analysts, admins, and stakeholders to gather requirements and propose solutions.
* Work independently with minimal guidance, taking ownership of assigned modules/projects end\-to\-end.

**Required Skills \& Experience**


* **9\+ years** of overall IT development experience, with **at least 1–2 years / 1–2 full\-cycle projects** specifically on the ServiceNow platform (custom application development, not just configuration).
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
	+ Glide APIs, Server\-side \& Client\-side scripting (JavaScript)
	+ Flow Designer / Workflow Editor
	+ Service Portal / Now Experience UI Builder
	+ App Engine Studio (for custom app development)
	+ Integration Hub, REST/SOAP Web Services, MID Server
	+ ACLs, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions
* Experience in at least one ServiceNow custom Application implementation
* Understanding of ServiceNow data model, tables, and CMDB (preferred).
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodology.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver without close supervision.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.

**Good to Have**


* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) or Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
* Exposure to DevOps practices for ServiceNow (source control, CI/CD for ServiceNow instances).
**Job Location:** Ahmedabad Bangalore Chennai Coimbatore Dehradun Hyderabad Mumbai Noida Pune

title: System Administrator - Intern
description:
**Location:** Ahmedabad (Work from Office)  
**Internship Timing:** 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM (Including 1 Hour Break)

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **System Admin Intern** to join our IT team. This internship is ideal for freshers or students who are eager to gain hands\-on experience in system administration, IT support, and infrastructure management. The intern will assist in maintaining computer systems, troubleshooting technical issues, and supporting day\-to\-day IT operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, and peripheral devices.
* Provide technical support to employees for hardware, software, and network\-related issues.
* Assist in setting up systems, user accounts, email IDs, and access permissions.
* Troubleshoot system, printer, and connectivity issues.
* Monitor system performance and ensure smooth day\-to\-day IT operations.
* Perform software installations, updates, and basic system maintenance.
* Maintain IT asset inventory and documentation.
* Support data backup and recovery activities.
* Assist in maintaining network devices such as routers, switches, and Wi\-Fi connectivity.
* Follow IT security policies and report any security concerns.
* Coordinate with the senior IT team for issue resolution and infrastructure support.

Eligibility

* Fresher or pursuing/completed Diploma, B.Sc. (IT), BCA, B.Tech, BE, MCA, or any equivalent qualification in Computer Science or Information Technology.
* Basic understanding of Windows operating systems, computer hardware, networking, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office and basic networking concepts is preferred.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.

Required Skills

* Basic computer hardware knowledge
* Operating System installation and troubleshooting
* Networking fundamentals (LAN/Wi\-Fi/IP)
* Microsoft Windows administration
* Technical troubleshooting
* Documentation and inventory management
* Teamwork and communication
* Time management and attention to detail

Internship Details

* **Position:** System Admin Intern
* **Location:** Ahmedabad
* **Work Mode:** Work from Office
* **Shift:** 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM (Including 1 Hour Break)
* **Experience:** Freshers are welcome to apply

Join us to gain practical exposure to IT infrastructure, system administration, and enterprise technical support while building a strong foundation for your career in Information Technology.

Pay: From ₹3,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
